mapper.insert: INSERT INTO case_report ( student_id, counselor_id, problem_type_id, total_sessions, effect_self_rating, case_summary, counseling_effect, suggestion, close_type, report_status, create_time ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{counselorId}, #{problemTypeId}, #{totalSessions}, #{effectSelfRating}, #{caseSummary}, #{counselingEffect}, #{suggestion}, #{closeType}, #{reportStatus}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE case_report SET problem_type_id = #{problemTypeId}, total_sessions = #{totalSessions}, effect_self_rating = #{effectSelfRating}, case_summary = #{caseSummary}, counseling_effect = #{counselingEffect}, suggestion = #{suggestion}, close_type = #{closeType}, report_status = #{reportStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE case_report SET report_status = 'SUBMITTED', submit_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT cr.id, CONCAT('CR', DATE_FORMAT(cr.create_time, '%Y%m%d'), LPAD(cr.id, 4, '0')) AS reportNo, cr.student_id AS studentId, su.real_name AS studentName, sp.student_no AS studentNo, sp.college, COALESCE(sp.contact_phone, su.phone) AS phone, cr.problem_type_id AS problemTypeId, pt.type_name AS problemTypeLabel, cr.total_sessions AS totalSessions, cr.effect_self_rating AS effectSelfRating, cr.case_summary AS caseSummary, cr.counseling_effect AS counselingEffect, cr.suggestion, cr.close_type AS closeType, cr.report_status AS reportStatus, cr.submit_time AS submitTime, cr.update_time AS updateTime FROM case_report cr LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON cr.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON su.id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN problem_type pt ON cr.problem_type_id = pt.id
mapper.select: ORDER BY cr.update_time DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT cr.id, CONCAT('CR', DATE_FORMAT(cr.create_time, '%Y%m%d'), LPAD(cr.id, 4, '0')) AS reportNo, su.real_name AS studentName, sp.student_no AS studentNo, sp.gender, sp.college, COALESCE(sp.contact_phone, su.phone) AS phone, pt.type_name AS problemTypeLabel, cr.total_sessions AS totalSessions, cr.effect_self_rating AS effectSelfRating, cr.case_summary AS caseSummary, cr.suggestion, cr.report_status AS reportStatus FROM case_report cr LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON cr.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON su.id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN problem_type pt ON cr.problem_type_id = pt.id WHERE cr.id = #{id} AND cr.counselor_id = #{counselorId}

SELECT cr.id, CONCAT('CR', DATE_FORMAT(cr.create_time, '%Y%m%d'), LPAD(cr.id, 4, '0')) AS reportNo, su.real_name AS studentName, sp.student_no AS studentNo, sp.gender, sp.college, COALESCE(sp.contact_phone, su.phone) AS phone, pt.type_name AS problemTypeLabel, cr.total_sessions AS totalSessions, cr.effect_self_rating AS effectSelfRating, cr.case_summary AS caseSummary, cr.suggestion, cr.report_status AS reportStatus FROM case_report cr LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON cr.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON su.id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN problem_type pt ON cr.problem_type_id = pt.id WHERE cr.id = #{id} AND cr.report_status = 'SUBMITTED'
